title: Maximum thrust value
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the maximum thrust must be correctly stated, including units (N).

title: Initial pressure calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply force equilibrium on the pistons to calculate the initial gas pressure, accounting for atmospheric pressure, piston weights, and the inclined plane.

title: Final pressure application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Boyle's law to find the gas pressure when piston a reaches the bottom, using the initial pressure and the change in gas volume.

title: Force equilibrium for thrust
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the force equilibrium condition on the pistons at the moment piston a reaches the bottom to solve for the external thrust F.

title: Correct geometry and volumes
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly identify the initial and final volumes of the gas in the system, relating piston positions to cylinder heights and cross-sectional areas.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's working should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (Pa, m, m², kg) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes a sign error when summing forces on the pistons (e.g., direction of weight component, atmospheric pressure, or gas pressure forces).

title: Volume miscalculation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates the final gas volume, for example by not accounting for both cylinders or misinterpreting the piston movement.
